claims.claim_text: The indexed Staff Sergeant Walter H Peck is the soldier named in an official Army record and OSS Special Orders No. 9, which assigned him to Company B, Special Reconnaissance Battalion.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index, Army bulk record, and NARA scan agree on his exact name and protected identifier; the order also agrees on rank and documents an OSS internal assignment.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by two independent official records matching the indexed exact name and protected identifier, with the OSS order also matching rank.
claims.temporal_assessment: The 9 May 1945 order documents an internal OSS assignment and is deliberately not treated as a pre-OSS employer or predecessor affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier is used privately for identity resolution and omitted from the public claim and excerpt.
